newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France pilot strike hits cargo flights.
newsitem.headline: Air France pilot strike hits cargo flights.

text.p: Air France Cargo said strike action by pilots had meant it had maintained only two of its seven scheduled Boeing 747-200 freighter services from Paris today, May 21.
"The two 747F (operational) services are a code-shared flight with Japan Airlines to Tokyo/Narita and a Paris-New York-Mexico City-Los Angeles flight," an Air France Cargo official told Reuters.
The Paris-Toronto-Chicago freighter service scheduled for today has been postponed until May 24, the official added.

The strike is a resumption of a walkout that was threatened last month after talks with management broke down over a pay scale which would pay new pilots between nine and 30 percent less than current crews.

Air France said it was maintaining all its long-haul passenger flights despite the strike while around half of short-haul services and a quarter of medium-haul flights were cancelled. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
